chapter: Hampton band, Honolulu and the war years
title: Depression wages after leaving Hampton
summary: Back in Los Angeles he plays small casuals for $17.50 a week, far below union scale.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: cians. Among those were Don Byas, who later became famous all over America and Europe. At that time I was back in Los Angeles playing casuals, small jobs at Depression wages.
Depression wages you say? About what was that, Mr. Blakeney? What were the wages about that time?
Well, I was making $17.50 for seven days work.
No, the union scale was much more than that, but we didn't—
They allowed us to get what we could.
